sqlMap.select: SELECT es.application_number AS application_number, stn.program_id AS program_id, sas.application_document_path AS photo_path, sas.application_document_path AS signature_path, es.first_name AS student_name, es.date_of_birth AS dob, pm.program_name AS program_name FROM entity_student es JOIN student_application_status sas ON es.application_number = sas.application_number JOIN student_test_number stn ON stn.test_number = es.application_number LEFT JOIN program_master pm ON pm.program_id = stn.program_id WHERE es.application_number = #application_number# AND sas.verification_status = 'REC'
sqlMap.insert: INSERT INTO qr_attendance ( application_number, program_id, attendance_time, status, reason, userName ) VALUES ( #application_number#, #program_id#, NOW(), #status#, #reason#, #userName# )
sqlMap.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM edit_panel_authority WHERE user_name = #userName# AND password = SHA1(#password#) AND panel_authority = 'QR01'
